verdict.rationale: gstack is a locally installed skill pack for coding agents. Its docs say learnings are written to a fixed local path (~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl), and community comments note it collects usage telemetry. Because it does store and transmit data, a data-residency question is fair to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows any way to choose a storage region or residency for that data; the telemetry opt-out that commenters mention is not a residency control.
